findings.detail: The harness fixed object populations but did not compare fabric column/default details, constraint/index definitions, policy roles/expressions, complete function attributes/search paths, complete trigger properties or exact non-owner ACL populations. Same-name definition drift could therefore be released as an exact catalogue match.

Containment admission checked only tmpfs destination presence and omitted exact memory, CPU, PID, tmpfs option, port-binding and synthetic environment readback despite the plan requiring exact configuration facts.
Individual operations were bounded but docker_profile.total_timeout_seconds was not applied to the aggregate non-cleanup execution path.

recovery: Expand fixed catalogue projections, freeze exact PostgreSQL-16 query digests through a fresh-vetoed characterization-only run that cannot pass, enforce complete containment readback and an absolute execution deadline with cleanup reserve, then bind the observed digests and obtain another fresh exact-HEAD veto before the terminal run.
